name: Until Closing
source:
The world is ending. A zombie outbreak is spreading through the city, and a small neighborhood bar becomes your last refuge.

Inside, a bartender offers you a drink as if nothing unusual is happening.

Outside, the dead gather at the door.

Inside, time seems to stand still.

[From [url=https://puzzle-deluxe.itch.io/until-cloting]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
世界末日已然降临。丧尸疫情正在整座城市蔓延，而街角一家不起眼的小酒吧成了你最后的避难所。

酒吧里，调酒师神色如常地为你递上一杯酒，仿佛外面什么异常都没有发生。

门外，活死人正源源不断地聚拢在门前。

门内，时间仿佛彻底静止了下来。

[摘自[url=https://puzzle-deluxe.itch.io/until-cloting]itch.io[/url]]
